items.w: בך יהוה חסיתי אל אבושה לעולם בצדקתך פלטני
items.title: EMBARRASSMENT
items.quote: I have sought refuge with You, Hashem. Let me never feel embarrassed. In Your generous goodwill, save me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you and save you for you are depending on no one but Him. Ask that you never be embarrassed at having relied on Hashem.

items.title: INCLINE YOUR EAR
items.text: Tell Hashem that even if your tefillah is not sufficiently worthy to ascend to Him, He should incline His ear to you and hear you.

items.title: FORTRESS
items.quote: For You have been my towering Rock and You have been my Fortress.
items.text: Hashem is totally reliable, like the most impenetrable fortress.

items.title: ENTRUSTING MY LIFE
items.quote: I will entrust my living spirit into Your hand.
items.text: Appeal to Hashem to save you because you depend on Him alone.

items.title: TIME TO HATE
items.quote: I have come to hate those who depend on worthless fantasies.
items.text: Hatred of evil is sometimes necessary to avoid being caught up in it.

items.w: אגילה ואשמחה בחסדך אשר ראית את עניי
items.title: EMPATHY
items.quote: I will feel exultation. I will rejoice in Your loving kindness that You have seen my affliction.
items.text: Thank Hashem for His sympathetic and understanding care in easing your difficulties. When you realize His personal concern you should feel a burst of exultation.

items.title: FREE WILL
items.quote: You have set my feet on a wide-open place.
items.text: Thank Hashem for giving you the freedom to choose your way in life. Humbly ask for His guidance in making the right choice.

items.w: כי כלו ביגון חיי ושנותי באנחה
items.title: YEARS OF PAIN
items.quote: For my life is consumed with anguish and my years with sighing.
items.text: By declaring and contemplating your suffering, you are demonstrating that its purpose has been served and your tefillah for a yeshuah should be answered.

items.title: A SHINING FACE
items.quote: Shine Your face upon Your servant.
items.text: Ask Hashem to show you His love and goodwill. By shining His face openly upon you, the world will see that Hashem rewards those who are devoted to Him.

items.title: A SHINING FACE
items.quote: Shine Your face upon Your servant.
items.text: Emulate the attributes of Hashem and show goodwill towards all the people in your life. Showing a smile can be a great kindness.

items.quote: Hashem, let me not feel disheartened after having called upon You.

items.w: מה רב טובך אשר צפנת ליראיך
items.title: GOODNESS
items.quote: How abundant is Your goodness that You have hidden away for those who fear You.
items.text: Hashem’s true goodness is reserved for those who appreciate it.

items.w: ברוך יהוה כי הפליא חסדו לי בעיר מצור
items.title: SECURITY
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem, for He has been wondrously kind to me, [secure as] in a fortified city.
items.text: Thank Hashem for making you feel secure.

items.title: LOVE AND DEVOTION
items.quote: Love Hashem, all His devout ones!
items.text: Love of Hashem must be based on your complete and faithful devotion to Him alone.

items.w: חזקו ויאמץ לבבכם כל המיחלים ליהוה
items.title: COURAGE
items.quote: Be strong, and your hearts will take courage, all who wait longingly for Hashem.
items.text: No matter how difficult things are for you, have confidence that the yeshuah will surely come.
